summary: Declare exact native assistant diagnostics in the generated client contract

replay.detail: No replay trigger changes; outcomes remain normalized on owner reads.

schema.detail: The client JSON contract adds optional open TimelineViewAssistantError.native for exact native diagnostics. No SQLite schema or stored-state migration changes. This corrects the unchanged-client-schema description in native-outcomes-main-merge.json.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Regenerated clients accept and retain the optional native object. Existing assistant presentation fields and timeline kinds remain unchanged. Older tolerant clients may omit the new field; older strict JSON-schema clients must update to the generated contract before decoding views containing native. The transition applies from main and all earlier native-outcomes branch versions without intermediate data conversion.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption beyond normal member/client restart.

manual.detail: No operator data or configuration changes; deploy the matching generated client contract for strict consumers.

recovery.detail: Preserve native transcripts; no additional recovery procedure.
